lamia.name: Lamia
lamia.blurb: Just as they were cursed long ago, lamias can inflict a curse on those they touch, clouding the victim's mind and pushing conscious thought toward animalistic instincts. Creatures affected by this curse grow reckless, becoming unaware of the consequences of their own actions. This makes the hapless victim all the more susceptible to the lamia's cunning illusions and insidious charms. The lamia's animalistic nature and the effect of their cursed touch have led some scholars to theorize that the original lamias must have, millennia ago, turned away from their own reason and intellect and embraced the life of simple beasts. Whether this change was rewarded as a monstrous gift from Lamashtu or inflicted as a curse for abandoning their responsibilities by Pharasma, remains a subject of debate to this day.

abilities.name: Lamia's Caress
abilities.desc: The lamia touches a creature, who must succeed at a DC 23 Will save or become Stupefied 1. If the target fails additional saves against this ability, the condition value increases by 1 (to a maximum of stupefied 4). This condition value decreases by 1 every 24 hours.

abilities.name: Grab
abilities.desc:
Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

ferrugon.name: Ferrugon
ferrugon.blurb: These ram-headed devils have wings and flesh made of rusted metal. They're forged from the souls of damned mortals who made others suffer through their creative work. They like to tempt those of the same ilk, driving auteurs and stage directors to cruelty in the pursuit of greatness. Ferrugons also enjoy pushing artists to extremes in order to break them. They dip the bodies of mortals they've driven to despair into molten metal to make horrifically malformed statues, which they then add to their lairs.
ferrugon.saveNote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

abilities.name: Greater Darkvision
abilities.desc: A creature with greater darkvision can see perfectly well in areas of darkness and dim light, though such vision is in black and white only. A creature with greater darkvision can see through even forms of magical darkness.

abilities.name: Telepathy 100 feet
abilities.desc: A monster with telepathy can communicate mentally with any creatures within the listed radius, as long as they share a language. This doesn't give any special access to their thoughts, and communicates no more information than normal speech would.

abilities.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
Metallic
abilities.desc: A ferrugon is a metallic creature and thus affected by effects such as the circumstance penalty inflicted by Thunderstrike.

abilities.name: Vainglorious Whispers
abilities.desc:
Trigger A non-devil creature within 30 feet of the ferrugon succeeds (but doesn't critically succeed) at an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw

Effect The ferrugon whispers subversive messages to the triggering creature, causing it to become overly confident in its abilities, while in fact it becomes less accomplished overall. The target must attempt a DC 32 Will save. On a failure, the target gains a +2 status bonus to saving throws against fear effects but also takes a –2 penalty to all attack rolls and skill checks for 1 hour. During this time, the victim can't benefit from Aid reactions, use healing effects on themselves, or use Take Cover or Raise a Shield actions, as these actions seem unnecessary to the creature at this time. Similar defensive actions might not be available to the victim as well, at the GM's discretion. The target is then temporarily immune to Vainglorious Whispers for 24 hours.

Effect: Vainglorious Whispers

abilities.name: Ferrugon Tetanus
abilities.desc:
Saving Throw DC 32 Fortitude save

Onset 1d4 days

Stage 1 Clumsy 1 (1 week)

Stage 2 Clumsy 2 and can't speak (1 day)

Stage 3 Paralyzed (1 day)

Stage 4 death

abilities.name: Sunder Objects
abilities.desc: When a ferrugon damages an item or structure, they deal an additional 2d8 damage to that item or structure.

6.n: Petrify (target is transformed into rusty iron, not stone)

5.n: Wall of Stone (wall is made of rusty iron, not stone) (3/day)

warmonger.name: Warmonger
warmonger.blurb: Warmongers believe the base state of life is violence. They stay in peak physical condition with constant training and keep their supplies ready for marching to war.

abilities.name: War Ready
abilities.desc: The warmonger can always roll Warfare Lore for initiative.

abilities.name: Pain Training
abilities.desc: The warmonger treats the value of any Drained, Dying, Enfeebled, Sickened, and Wounded conditions affecting them as 1 lower. The warmonger still has the condition and must remove it normally.

abilities.name: Reactive Strike
abilities.desc:
Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

abilities.name: Patch and Set
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per day

Requirements The warmonger has a hand free

Effect The warmonger grits their teeth and ties off a wound or sets a bone or joint. They regain 20 healing Hit Points.

abilities.name: Power Through
abilities.desc:
Requirements The warmonger is wielding two melee weapons and isn't Fatigued

Effect The warmonger attempts up to three melee Strikes against different creatures. These count toward the warmonger's multiple attack penalty normally, but the penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks. The warmonger overexerts themself with the attacks, becoming fatigued. The warmonger can attempt a DC 30 Fortitude save to recover from this fatigued condition at the start of each of their turns.

abilities.name: Sight Prey
abilities.desc:
The warmonger singles out one enemy to bring down with ranged attacks until the end of the current turn. The warmonger's ranged Strikes against that creature gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll and deal an extra 3d6 precision damage. Each time the warmonger hits that creature with a ranged Strike, the creature takes a –10-foot penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute and falls 20 feet if it's flying.

Effect: Sight Prey (Speed Penalty)

abilities.name: War Cry
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger The warmonger critically hits or knocks out an enemy

Effect The warmonger screams a battle cry. Each ally in a 30-foot emanation that hears it deals an additional 1d6 damage with its Strikes for 1 round.

Effect: War Cry

hundun-chaos-mage.name: Hundun Chaos Mage
hundun-chaos-mage.src: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege
hundun-chaos-mage.languageNote: can't speak any language, telepathy 100 feet
hundun-chaos-mage.saveNote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

abilities.name: Telepathy 100 feet
abilities.desc: A monster with telepathy can communicate mentally with any creatures within the listed radius, as long as they share a language. This doesn't give any special access to their thoughts, and communicates no more information than normal speech would.

abilities.name: Motion Sense 100 feet
abilities.desc: A hundun chaos mage can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

abilities.name: Constant Spells
abilities.desc: A constant spell affects the monster without the monster needing to cast it, and its duration is unlimited. If a constant spell gets counteracted, the monster can reactivate it by spending the normal spellcasting actions the spell requires.

abilities.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
Entropic Feedback
abilities.desc:
Trigger A creature attempts to target the hundun with a mental effect

Effect The triggering creature is subject to the utter chaos of the hundun's mind and must attempt a DC 40 Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 10d6 mental damage.

Failure The creature takes 10d6 mental damage, is Drained 1, and is Stupefied 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is Drained 2 and Stupefied 2.

abilities.name: Activate Attractor
abilities.desc:
The hundun releases its staff-like attractor, which hovers in place. The hundun can use an action, which has the concentrate trait, to move the attractor up to 60 feet, to a maximum of 300 feet from the hundun. It can also use an action, which has the concentrate trait, to recall the attractor, which flies to the hundun and immediately deactivates.

Creatures within 40 feet of the attractor must attempt a DC 40 Will save if they're within the area when the attractor is activated or as soon as they enter the area while it's active. Once a creature has attempted the save, it uses the same result for the rest of that activation of the attractor.

Any restrictions on a creature's movement apply only if it voluntarily moves away from the attractor. For example, if the attractor moves closer to a creature, the creature doesn't then need to move away.

Chaotic creatures are immune to the effects of the attractor.

The attractor can't be harmed by physical attacks but is destroyed by Disintegrate, Disjunction, a Rod of Cancellation, a Sphere of Annihilation, and other similarly powerful effects.

The attractor has an AC of 40 and a counteract DC of 37. A hundun can rebuild a destroyed attractor after 1d8 hours of uninterrupted meditation. If the hundun is slain, its attractor disappears.

Critical Success The creature's movement isn't restricted.

Success The creature treats each square in the area as difficult terrain when moving away from the attractor.

Failure The creature can't move away from the attractor within the area.

abilities.name: Flurry of Blows
abilities.desc: The hundun makes two Strikes with its fist. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

abilities.name: Iron Command
abilities.desc:
Trigger An enemy within 15 feet damages Seldeg

Effect Seldeg puts an impertinent foe who dared harm him in their proper place. He commands the enemy to kneel in obedience. If they refuse, they must pay the price in pain and anguish. The triggering creature must choose one of the following options: the enemy kneels, dropping Prone as a free action, or the enemy refuses and takes 6d6 mental damage. In addition, Seldeg's Strikes against the triggering creature deal an additional 3 damage until the end of his next turn. Seldeg chooses whether the additional damage is spirit or void each time he uses this reaction.

abilities.name: Raise a Shield
abilities.desc:
Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You position your shield to protect yourself. When you have Raised a Shield, you gain its listed circumstance bonus to AC. Your shield remains raised until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Reactive Strike
abilities.desc:
Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

abilities.name: Rejuvenation
abilities.desc:
When a graveknight is destroyed, their armor rebuilds their body over the course of 1d10 days—or more quickly if the armor is worn by a living host. If the body is destroyed before then, the process restarts.

A graveknight can only be permanently destroyed by obliterating their armor (such as with Disintegrate), transporting it to the Forge of Creation, or throwing it into the heart of a volcano.

abilities.name: Sacrilegious Aura
abilities.desc:
30 feet.

When a creature in the aura uses a vitality spell or ability, the graveknight automatically attempts to counteract it, with a counteract modifier of +31.

abilities.name: Shield Block
abilities.desc:
Trigger The monster has its shield raised and takes damage from a physical attack.

Effect The monster snaps its shield into place to deflect a blow. The shield prevents the monster from taking an amount of damage up to the shield's Hardness. The monster and the shield each take any remaining damage, possibly breaking or destroying the shield.

abilities.name: Void Healing
abilities.desc: A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

abilities.name: Devastating Blast
abilities.desc:
Seldeg Bheldis unleashes a 30-foot cone of energy. Creatures in the area take 11d12 fire damage with a basic DC 39 Reflex save.

Seldeg can use this ability once every 1d4 rounds.

abilities.name: Graveknight's Curse
abilities.desc:
This curse affects anyone who wears a graveknight's armor for at least 1 hour

Saving Throw DC 39 Will save

Onset 1 hour

Stage 1 Doomed 1 and can't remove armor (1 day)

Stage 2 Doomed 2, –10-foot status penalty to Speeds, and can't remove armor (1 day)

Stage 3 dies and transforms into the Seldeg.

abilities.name: Phantom Mount
abilities.desc:
HP 155; AC 42, Fort +32, Ref +28, Will +29

Seldeg summons a supernatural mount, as Marvelous Mount (rank 10). Unlike marvelous mount, the steed's AC and saving throw bonuses are all 4 lower than the graveknight's, and the steed has one-third the Seldeg's Hit Points (rounded down).

If the steed is destroyed, Seldeg must wait 1 hour before using this ability again.

abilities.name: Ruinous Weapons
abilities.desc: Any weapon or unarmed attack Seldeg uses gains the effects of the +1 greater striking and greater flaming runes.

abilities.name: Swap Fates
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per round

Effect Seldeg switches the fates of two creatures within 500 feet. The two creatures teleport into each other's spaces. Each creature then attempts a DC 39 Will save.

Critical Success The target becomes temporarily immune to Swap Fates for 24 hours.

Success The target takes 3d6 mental damage.

Failure The target takes 6d6 mental damage and is Stunned 1.

Critical Failure The target takes 12d6 mental damage and is Stunned 4.

abilities.name: Unyielding Block
abilities.desc: At the start of each of Seldeg's turns, he gains two additional reactions he can use only to perform a Shield Block.

abilities.name: Weapon Master
abilities.desc: Seldeg has access to the critical specialization effects of any weapon he wields.

urushil.name: Urushil
urushil.blurb: Mariliths are the generals of the Abyss, formed from the souls of proud evil mortals, often warlords and despots. They appear as tall and powerfully built humans from the waist up with snake tails and six arms. Because of Lamashtu's prominence over other demonic deities, most pride demons encountered by mortals take female form, but they can be of any gender.
urushil.saveNote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

abilities.name: Telepathy 100 feet
abilities.desc: A monster with telepathy can communicate mentally with any creatures within the listed radius, as long as they share a language. This doesn't give any special access to their thoughts, and communicates no more information than normal speech would.

abilities.name: Constant Spells
abilities.desc: A constant spell affects the monster without the monster needing to cast it, and its duration is unlimited. If a constant spell gets counteracted, the monster can reactivate it by spending the normal spellcasting actions the spell requires.

abilities.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
Attack of Opportunity (Special)
abilities.desc:
A marilith gains 5 extra reactions per round that they can use only to make Attacks of Opportunity. The demon can't use more than one on the same triggering action, even if a creature leaves several squares in the marilith's reach, and the marilith must use a different weapon for each Attack of Opportunity.

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

abilities.name: Commander's Aura
abilities.desc:
100 feet. Commanded or allied evil creatures in the aura of lower level than the marilith gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, AC, saves, and skill checks.

Effect: Commander's Aura

abilities.name: Failure Vulnerability
abilities.desc: A marilith's pride feeds their strength, so the sting of failure wounds them. If the marilith uses a damaging spell or makes a Strike on their turn but doesn't deal any damage that turn, they take 3d6+10 mental damage at the end of their turn and their commander's aura deactivates until the end of their next turn.

abilities.name: Bladestorm
abilities.desc: The marilith makes up to six longsword Strikes, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the marilith's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks.

abilities.name: Defensive Assault
abilities.desc: The marilith makes two Strikes, each with a different weapon, and they use the remaining weapons for protection. The demon gains a circumstance bonus to AC for 1 round equal to the number of weapons not used for attacks. If the marilith later uses any of those weapons to attack (including for an Attack of Opportunity), the bonus to AC decreases by 1 for each weapon used.

abilities.name: Focused Assault
abilities.desc: The marilith attacks a single target with all the weapons they wield in their arms, overwhelming the target with multiple attacks and leaving almost nowhere to dodge. The demon makes a longsword Strike. On a successful attack, the marilith deals longsword damage to the target, plus an additional 1d8 slashing damage for every longsword they wield beyond the first (typically 5d8 slashing damage). Even on a failed attack, the marilith deals the damage from one longsword to the target, though they still miss completely on a critical failure. This counts toward the marilith's multiple attack penalty as a number of attacks equal to the number of longswords the pride demon wields.

abilities.name: Greater Constrict
abilities.desc:
2d12+13 bludgeoning, basic DC 41 Fortitude save

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC. A creature that fails this save falls Unconscious, and a creature that succeeds is then temporarily immune to falling unconscious from Greater Constrict for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Infuse Weapons
abilities.desc: Any weapon becomes a +2 Greater Striking weapon made of cold iron and silver while a marilith wields it.

abilities.name: Grab
abilities.desc:
Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

abilities.name: Flurry of Blows
abilities.desc: Han makes two Strikes with his fist or with a monk weapon. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

abilities.name: Knocking Sweep
abilities.desc: Han swings their weapon with a sweeping spin. They attempt separate Athletics check to Trip any number of creatures within their reach. Each attempt counts toward the ki adept's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after they makes all the attacks.

abilities.name: Powerful Fists
abilities.desc: Han's fist Strikes are treated as cold iron and silver and don't take penalties when making lethal attacks.

abilities.name: Powerful Uppercut
abilities.desc:
Han delivers a devastating uppercut. He makes an unarmed Strike. On a hit, the Strike deals an additional 1d10 bludgeoning damage and the target must attempt a DC 28 Fortitude save. Regardless of the result, Han becomes Stunned 1.

Success No further effect.

Failure The target is knocked off balance and takes a -1 circumstance penalty to its attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the target is knocked Prone.

abilities.name: Punch Down
abilities.desc: Han deals an extra 2d10 damage to Prone creatures.

abilities.name: Knockdown
abilities.desc:
Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Knockdown in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Trip the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty.

abilities.name: Electric Shroud
abilities.desc:
Trigger A creature hits Krankkiss with an unarmed attack.

Effect Krankkiss focuses his ki power to produce electricity. The triggering creature takes 2d6 electricity damage.

abilities.name: Flurry of Blows
abilities.desc: Krankkiss makes two Strikes with his fist or with a monk weapon. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

abilities.name: Knocking Sweep
abilities.desc: Krankkiss swings their weapon with a sweeping spin. They attempt separate Athletics check to Trip any number of creatures within their reach. Each attempt counts toward the ki adept's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after they makes all the attacks.

abilities.name: Powerful Fists
abilities.desc: Krankkiss' fist Strikes are treated as cold iron and silver and don't take penalties when making lethal attacks.

abilities.name: Punch Down
abilities.desc: Krankkiss deals an extra 2d10 damage to Prone creatures.

abilities.name: Knockdown
abilities.desc:
Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Knockdown in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Trip the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty.

oath-howler.name: Oath Howler
oath-howler.blurb: Sometimes the wind catches a profane oath as it's uttered, carrying it far away before the blasphemy can form a tortured eddy that repeats the curse again and again. Such winds eventually tie themselves in a knot and take on a sinister intelligence.
oath-howler.saveNote: +2 status to all saves vs. auditory and sonic

abilities.name: Oathsense
abilities.desc: The oath howler can hear profanities—anything from foul language to someone casting an unholy spell that lacks the subtle trait—uttered within 1 mile, after which they can detect the speaker as a vague sense for 1 minute (or as an imprecise sense within 100 feet). The oath howler can understand profanities in any language, including several words that precede and follow the profanity for context, and thereafter can mimic and repeat those profanities.

abilities.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Auditory and Sonic
Rebuking Smoke
abilities.desc:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet damages the oath howler

Effect The oath howler's wound belches foul smoke onto the triggering creature, who must attempt a DC 30 Fortitude save. The creature is then immune to that oath howler's Rebuking Smoke for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled for 1 round and Sickened 1.

Critical Failure The creature is sickened 1 and Blinded until the sickened condition ends.

abilities.name: Storm of Blasphemies
abilities.desc:
The oath howler roars in a 30-foot cone, shouting dozens of pejoratives in as many languages. Creatures in the area take 10d8 sonic damage (basic DC 33 Fortitude save). Creatures that critically fail also take 2d8 persistent sonic damage and are Deafened until the persistent damage ends.

The oath howler can't use this ability again for 1d4 rounds.

abilities.name: Swiftness
abilities.desc: The oath howler's movement doesn't trigger reactions.

tanglebones.name: Tanglebones
tanglebones.blurb: Sometimes, when murderer buries a large number of victims in a mass grave, the vengeful spirits of the slain can become similarly tangled together. When these spirits can't untangle, they instead return to their physical remains, fusing into one horrific mass of bones and black, tar-like sludge-a tanglebones.

abilities.name: Ectoplasmic Filament
abilities.desc:
Trigger A creature within the tanglebone's reach uses an action with the manipulate trait or a move action, or leaves a square during a move action it's using

Effect A filament of black, oily ectoplasm lashes out at the triggering creature, dealing 2d8+8 slashing damage (basic DC 25 Reflex save). If the filament deals damage, the tanglebones gains 2d8 temporary Hit Points.

abilities.name: Eerie Flexibility
abilities.desc: A tanglebones can shift and adjust its mass to fit into smaller areas, allowing it to fit through tight spaces as if it were a Medium creature. While Squeezing, it can move at its full Speed.

abilities.name: Void Healing
abilities.desc: A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

abilities.name: Gnaw
abilities.desc:
Requirements The tanglebones has Grabbed a foe

Effect The tanglebones gnaws and chews on the grabbed target with its many skulls, dealing 2d6+8 piercing damage (basic DC 23 Fortitude save). On a critical failure, the creature is also Sickened 1 from the pain.

abilities.name: Skeletal Storm
abilities.desc: The tanglebones makes a single claw Strike against every creature in reach. These attacks count toward the tanglebones' multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the tanglebones makes all its attacks.

abilities.name: Sprawled Bones
abilities.desc: Until the next time it acts, the tanglebones appears as a sprawling mass of bones. It has an automatic result of 35 on Deception checks and DCs to pass as a grisly but seemingly harmless mess.

abilities.name: Grab
abilities.desc:
Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

metal-rascal.name: Metal Rascal
metal-rascal.src: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-10: The Crocodile's Smile
metal-rascal.blurb: The capricious and destructive metal scamps are self-appointed forces of entropy, taking great pleasure in indiscriminately wrecking everything around them, sometimes even to their own detriment. Metal scamps have a severe appearance, with pointed facial features and angular limbs, and their skin can be the color of any metal, often heavily oxidized as if by years of exposure to the elements.

abilities.name: Fast Healing 2 (While Touching Metal)
abilities.desc: A monster with this ability regains the given number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn.

abilities.name: Breathe Shrapnel
abilities.desc:
The metal scamp breathes a 15-foot cone of jagged metal flakes that deals 2d4 slashing,1d4 bleed damage to each creature within the area (basic DC 17 Reflex save).

The metal scamp can't Breathe Shrapnel again for 1d4 rounds.

elite-arisen-umbral-pixie.name: Elite Arisen Umbral Pixie
elite-arisen-umbral-pixie.src: Pathfinder Society Quest #15: In the Footsteps of Horror

abilities.name: Void Healing
abilities.desc: A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

abilities.name: Shadowed Illumination
abilities.desc: Umbral pixies exude shadow, counteracting all other light and darkness effects their level or lower to leave dim light out to 10 feet (counteract rank 4, counteract bonus +12). The shadow pixie can suppress this effect with a single action, which has the concentrate trait. While the effect is suppressed, the shadow pixie's Strikes don't deal cold damage and they can't use their shadow spark Strike.

manifestation-of-nightmare.name: Manifestation of Nightmare
manifestation-of-nightmare.src: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-09: The Power of Legends

abilities.name: Reactive Strike
abilities.desc:
Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

abilities.name: Constrict Mind
abilities.desc: The manifestation of nightmare deals 2d6+6 mental damage to any number of creatures that are Grabbed or Restrained by it (basic DC 25 Will save). Creatures that fail the save are Frightened 1, or Frightened 2 on a critical failure.

abilities.name: Morphic Limb
abilities.desc: A manifestation of nightmare can form up to 8 morphic limbs at the same time. These limbs are constantly shifting their features according to the manifestation's whims, becoming fists, claws, pincers, blades, and anything else that it can imagine.

abilities.name: Recurring Nightmare
abilities.desc: A Frightened creature that is being Grabbed by a manifestation of nightmare can't reduce the value of its frightened condition below 1 until it Escapes.

abilities.name: Unnerving Echo
abilities.desc: If the manifestation of nightmare critically hits with a nightmare vision Strike, the target is Frightened 1.

abilities.name: Grab
abilities.desc:
Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

venexus.name: Venexus
venexus.saveNote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

abilities.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
Freezing Blood
abilities.desc:
Trigger An adjacent creature deals piercing or slashing damage to Venexus

Effect Venexus's blood splatters onto the triggering creature, dealing 2d6 cold damage. A creature that takes cold damage in this way is Slowed 1 for 1 round.

abilities.name: Frightful Presence
abilities.desc:
90 feet. DC 25 Will save

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

abilities.name: Mist Shroud
abilities.desc: 10 feet. The Primordial Flame continually heats the cold emanating from Venexus's body, surrounding the dragon in a thin veil of fog. Creatures in the aura are Concealed, and other creatures are concealed to creatures in the area. Venexus's storm vision allows her to see through this concealment, however. If wind disperses the aura, it returns automatically at the start of Venexus's turn. The aura is suppressed in water.

abilities.name: Storm Vision
abilities.desc: Inclement weather doesn't impair Venexus's vision; she ignores Concealment from fog, mist, rain, and snowfall.

abilities.name: Breath Weapon
abilities.desc: Venexus breathes a cloud of frost that deals 10d6 cold damage in a 40-foot cone (basic DC 28 Reflex save). She can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

abilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
abilities.desc: Venexus makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

abilities.name: Draconic Momentum
abilities.desc: When Venexus scores a critical hit with a Strike, she recharges her Breath Weapon.

abilities.name: Ice Climb 30 feet
abilities.desc: Venexus can climb on ice as though she had the listed climb Speed. She ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain from ice and snow and doesn't risk falling when crossing ice.

abilities.name: Shape Ice
abilities.desc: Venexus magically reshapes a cube of ice or snow she touches, up to 10 feet across. Any creature standing atop the ice must succeed at a DC 15 Reflex save or Acrobatics check. On a failure, the creature falls Prone on the ice; on a critical failure, it falls off the ice entirely and is also prone.

abilities.name: Snuff
abilities.desc: Venexus releases a wave of sleet, which douses open flames within 30 feet. All non-magical fire is automatically extinguished. All creatures in the area suffering from persistent fire damage immediately attempt a DC 10 flat check to end the persistent damage. If Snuff overlaps with an ongoing fire effect, Snuff attempts to counteract the fire effect.

monk-of-kugaptee.name: Monk of Kugaptee
monk-of-kugaptee.src: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
monk-of-kugaptee.blurb: A monk who violated their monastic vows in life might arise after death to become an undead horror known as a kurobozu. These predators feast upon the breath of mortals, creeping on twisted limbs into bedrooms to steal the life from sleeping victims. This act of feeding leaves its mark on the victim in the form of a vile scent of rot on the victim's breath and a debilitating disease that eventually results in exhaustion and finally death.

abilities.name: Void Healing
abilities.desc: A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

abilities.name: Brawling Critical
abilities.desc: When a monk of Kugaptee scores a critical hit with a fist Strike or a weapon with the monk trait, the target must succeed at a DC 24 Fortitude save or be Slowed 1 until the end of the monk's next turn.

abilities.name: Sagebane
abilities.desc:
When the monk of Kugaptee damages a living creature with a fist Strike or a weapon with the monk trait, the target must succeed at a DC 24 Fortitude save or become Stupefied 1 for 1 minute.

Further damage dealt by the monk of Kugaptee resets the duration to 1 minute and increases the stupefied value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of stupefied 4.

abilities.name: Scarlet Apoxia
abilities.desc:
The target can't recover from the Fatigued condition caused by scarlet apoxia until the disease is cured

Saving Throw DC 24 Fortitude save

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 Drained 1 and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 3 Drained 2 and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 4 dead (a creature that dies of scarlet apoxia reincarnates as a nindoru of equal or lower level 24 hours after death unless the body is given a proper funeral; once reincarnation occurs, the dead creature can't be restored to its original life until after the nindoru it reincarnates into is first slain)

abilities.name: Steal Breath
abilities.desc:
Requirements The monk of Kugaptee is adjacent to a living creature that's Paralyzed, Slowed, Stunned, or Unconscious

Effect The monk of Kugaptee leans over and sucks the breath from the target, who must attempt a DC 22 Fortitude save. Regardless of the result, the creature is exposed to scarlet apoxia and its breath reeks of rotting wildflowers for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't speak for 1 minute.

Failure The creature becomes Sickened 2 and can't speak for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the creature falls unconscious and begins suffocating.

abilities.name: Stunning Flurry
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per round

Effect The monk of Kugaptee makes two fist Strikes. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purposes of resistances and weaknesses, and the target must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude save or be Stunned 1 (or Stunned 3 on a critical failure); this save has the incapacitation trait.

irshandi.name: Irshandi
irshandi.src: Pathfinder #211: The Secret of Deathstalk Tower

abilities.name: Tremorsense (Imprecise) 60 feet
abilities.desc: Tremorsense allows a monster to feel the vibrations through a solid surface caused by movement. It is an imprecise sense with a limited range (listed in the ability). Tremorsense functions only if the monster is on the same surface as the subject, and only if the subject is moving along (or burrowing through) the surface.

abilities.name: Miasma
abilities.desc:
20 foot. DC 37 Fortitude save.

A creature that enters the aura or begins its turn there becomes Sickened 2 on a failure (or Sickened 4 on a critical failure). An animal, fey, or plant that rolls a failure gets a critical failure instead. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to the siabrae's miasma for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Rejuvenation
abilities.desc: When a siabrae is destroyed, they can attempt a DC 10 flat check (they automatically succeed if they're standing on blighted or diseased terrain, and automatically fail if they're standing on sacred ground). If the flat check succeeds, the siabrae's body crumbles to dust and absorbs into the earth. After 1d10 days, the siabrae's body reforms from a mass of unworked stone large enough to create a new body; this stone is in a random location within 1d10 miles of where the siabrae was destroyed. The siabrae emerges from the stone with a peal of thunder, though without any of their gear.

abilities.name: Void Healing
abilities.desc: A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

abilities.name: Blight Mastery
abilities.desc: Any of the siabrae's spells or effects that would normally be restricted to affecting animals can also affect undead animals. Furthermore, any animals the siabrae takes the form of or summons appear to be diseased, malnourished, or even dead and rotting. (This doesn't affect their statistics.)

abilities.name: Earth Glide
abilities.desc: The siabrae can Burrow through any earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, the siabrae moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

abilities.name: Steady Spellcasting
abilities.desc: If a reaction would disrupt the siabrae's spellcasting action, the siabrae attempts a DC 15 flat check. On a success, the action isn't disrupted.

abilities.name: Stony Shards
abilities.desc: Tiny shards break off the siabrae's antlers when they attack, lodging in the target's wounds and inflicting a terrible curse. A creature damaged by a siabrae's stone antlers Strike must succeed at a DC 37 Fortitude save or become Clumsy 2 for 1d4 rounds on a failure. If the creature critically fails, or fails while already clumsy 2 or greater, the creature is petrified.

abilities.name: Death Throes
abilities.desc: When the gold defender is destroyed, it melts into worthless slag. As it melts, it releases a 10-foot burst cloud of fumes and a 10-foot radius puddle of molten metal. Creatures that breathe fumes are exposed to gold defender poison. Creatures that move through the puddle take 10d6 fire damage. The fumes dissipate after 1 round and the puddle cools after 1 minute.

abilities.name: Golem Antimagic
abilities.desc:
Harmed by cold (6d10 untyped, 2d8 untyped from areas or persistent damage); healed by fire (area 2d8 healing HP); slowed by acid

A golem is immune to spells and magical abilities other than its own, but each type of golem is affected by a few types of magic in special ways. These exceptions are listed in shortened form in the golem's stat block, with the full rules appearing here. If an entry lists multiple types (such as "cold and water"), either type of spell can affect the golem.

  • Harmed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to take the listed amount of damage (this damage has no type) instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of magic of this type or is affected by a persistent effect of the appropriate type, it takes the damage listed in the parenthetical.
  • Healed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem makes the golem lose the slowed condition and gain HP equal to half the damage the spell would have dealt. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it gains the HP listed in the parenthetical.
  • Slowed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to be Slowed 1 for 2d6 rounds instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it's slowed 1 for that round.
  • Vulnerable To Each golem is vulnerable to one or more specific spells, with the effects described in its stat block.

abilities.name: Malleable Shape
abilities.desc: The gold defender's body is made from soft gold, which is particularly pliable. If the gold defender is critically hit with an attack that deals bludgeoning damage, the attack partially bends and reshapes the gold defender. The gold defender becomes Clumsy 2 until it spends an Interact action to bend itself back into shape.

abilities.name: Vulnerable to Telekinetic Haul
abilities.desc: Casting Telekinetic Haul on the gold defender squeezes its form, compressing it into a smaller and much more awkward shape. The gold defender becomes Clumsy 3 and can't use Light Reflection. The gold defender must take a 1-minute activity, which has the manipulate trait, to restore its shape, removing the clumsy condition and restoring its Light Reflection.

abilities.name: Gold Defender Poison
abilities.desc:
Any Drained value from this poison is reduced by 1 every hour

Saving Throw DC 33 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 2d6 poison and Drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 4d6 poison and Drained 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 8d6 poison and Drained 3 (1 round).

abilities.name: Inexorable March
abilities.desc: The gold defender Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a DC 37 Fortitude save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise, it is damaged as if hit by the defender's fist Strike.

abilities.name: Light Reflection
abilities.desc:
Requirements The gold defender is not in darkness

Effect The gold defender reshapes its skin into a reflective surface that magnifies ambient light into a precise beam that burns all creatures in a 30-foot cone, dealing 14d6 fire damage (DC 31 Reflex save if the gold defender is in dim light, DC 33 Reflex save if it's in bright light). It can't use Light Reflection again for 1d4 rounds.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and catches fire, taking 1d6 persistent fire damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the persistent fire damage is 5d6 persistent fire.

abilities.name: Helm Dependent
abilities.desc: Deravon is incorporeal, but the magical helm he wears is physical, perched atop his head as securely as if he were a physical creature. He cannot pass through solid objects while wearing his helm, but without it he is weakened. A PC can remove his helm with a DC 27 Athletics check to Disarm, and if Deravon's ghost critically fails a Reflex save, he must immediately attempt a second Reflex save against the same DC. On a failure, his helm topples from his head. While he can move through solid objects while his helm is off, he can't use Aeon Stars or Bow Before Me, and is Slowed 1 as long as he remains without his helm.

abilities.name: Rejuvenation
abilities.desc:
Destroying Deravon's link to the world—his magical helm—prevents him from rejuvenating and allows him to move on to the afterlife once he is destroyed.

When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after 2d4 days within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

abilities.name: Site Bound
abilities.desc: Deravon's ghost can travel anywhere in the Sanctum of Aroden (areas B29–B34) but not beyond.

abilities.name: Void Healing
abilities.desc: A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

abilities.name: Aeon Star's Curse
abilities.desc:
Deravon's ghost has four tiny motes of darkness that constantly orbit the glowing helm atop his head. When he activates the Aeon Star's Curse, one of these motes of darkness fires from its orbit to strike a living creature within 120 feet. That creature takes 5d6 spirit damage and must attempt a DC 28 Will save. An expended Aeon Star returns to its orbit around Deravon's head automatically after 1 hour has passed, but if no Aeon Stars orbit his head, Deravon's ghost can't activate Aeon Star's Curse, and the Athletics check to Disarm his helm drops to DC 23.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 2d6 spirit damage.

Failure The creature takes 4d6 spirit damage and becomes Stupefied 1 with an unlimited duration.

Critical Failure The creature takes 8d6 spirit damage and becomes Stupefied 2 with an unlimited duration. In addition, they suffer from an overwhelming conviction that, at any moment, the Aeon Star might appear in the sky above, portending the end of all things. As long as they remain outdoors during the day or indoors or underground at any time of day, the cursed character is Off-Guard from this constant distraction. While outdoors at night, the cursed character is also Slowed 1 from this spiritual conviction.

abilities.name: Bow Before Me
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per round

Effect Deravon's ghost can use the "Bow Before Aroden" activation of his helm at will as a single action once per round rather than once per day as a two-action activity, as long as the command he issues is to bow before him and not before Aroden.

abilities.name: Slice of Death
abilities.desc:
Deravon's ghost swings his ghostly longsword in an arc before him, unleashing a 30-foot cone of void energy. Creatures in the area take 8d6 void damage and must make a DC 28 Fortitude save against the following additional effects. Deravon's ghost can't use Slice Of Death for 1d4 rounds.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage and is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and an additional 2d6 persistent void damage as their flesh begins to rot away.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, 2d6 persistent void damage, and becomes Slowed 1 as long as they continue taking the persistent void damage as their body begins to stiffen up as if from rigor mortis.

heart-of-sarnax.name: Heart of Sarnax
heart-of-sarnax.blurb: When Sarnax sought to purge his soul of all evils, the result was a physical manifestation of crystal that approximated the size and shape of his heart. The evil contained within remained quiescent as long as Sarnax lived, but upon his death, the item gained power, no longer held in check by Sarnax's living soul. If returned to any version of the living Sarnax, this grown evil manifests into a creature made of solid ruby whose first and primary goal is the destruction of its source. Afterward, the Heart of Sarnax can turn its attention to the world, eager to visit upon reality all the evils, both petty and potent, that Sarnax might have pursued had he fallen from grace while alive.

abilities.name: Hear Heartbeat
abilities.desc: The Heart of Sarnax can hear a living creature's heartbeat as a precise sense in the listed range.

abilities.name: Speak to Inner Evils
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per round

Effect The Heart of Sarnax speaks to a creature it can hear the heartbeat of within 60 feet, beckoning that creature to give in to their inner desires to commit evil acts. The Heart of Sarnax attempts an Intimidation check against the target's Will DC, with the following results.

Critical Success The inner evils take over fully, and the target becomes Confused for 1 minute. While confused, the creature will never attack the Heart of Sarnax, attacking themself instead if the Heart of Sarnax is the only viable target. The Heart of Sarnax becomes Quickened for 1 round, and can use the extra action only to Speak to Inner Evils.

Success The inner evils take over only briefly. The creature becomes confused for 1 round.

Failure The inner evils fail to take over fully but are still distracting. The creature becomes Off-Guard until the end of their next turn.

Critical Failure The creature resists their inner evils and is immune to Speak to Inner Evils from this point on. The Heart of Sarnax recoils in shock, taking 4d6 mental damage (basic DC 25 Will save).

abilities.name: Void Beam
abilities.desc: The Heart of Sarnax fires a 60-foot line of spiraling, shadowy void energy from the cavity in its chest. Creatures in the area take 7d6 void damage (basic DC 24 Fortitude save). The Heart of Sarnax can't use Void Beam again for 1d4 rounds.

balor.name: Balor
balor.blurb: When folk whisper frightened tales of the demonic, what most envision is the balor-a towering figure of fire and flesh, a horned nightmare armed with a flaming whip and a sword flying through the night in search of its latest victim. On the Abyss, balors serve demon lords as generals or captains, and they typically command vast legions of demons. Standing at 14 feet in height, only the cruelest mortal souls-those who devoted entire lives to sins too numerous to count-can fuel the formation of a balor. More often, a balor forms from a mass of dozens of mortal souls who shared debased ideologies in life.
balor.saveNote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

abilities.name: Telepathy 100 feet
abilities.desc: A monster with telepathy can communicate mentally with any creatures within the listed radius, as long as they share a language. This doesn't give any special access to their thoughts, and communicates no more information than normal speech would.

abilities.name: Constant Spells
abilities.desc: A constant spell affects the monster without the monster needing to cast it, and its duration is unlimited. If a constant spell gets counteracted, the monster can reactivate it by spending the normal spellcasting actions the spell requires.

abilities.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
Attack of Opportunity (Special)
abilities.desc:
The balor can use Attack of Opportunity when a creature within their reach uses a concentrate action, in addition to its normal trigger. They can disrupt triggering concentrate actions, and they disrupt actions on any hit, not just a critical hit.

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

abilities.name: Aura of Flame
abilities.desc: 20 feet. A foe that starts its turn in the aura takes 3d6+10 fire damage, or 6d6+20 fire damage if the balor has Grabbed or Restrained it. A creature that hits a balor with an unarmed Strike takes 3d6+10 fire damage, and weapons that hit a balor take 3d6+10 fire damage.

abilities.name: Death Throes
abilities.desc: When a balor dies, their body explodes in a 100-foot aura of intense demonic flame. All creatures and objects in range take 16d10 fire damage (basic DC 45 Reflex save). Because the flame is infused with Abyssal energy, creatures in the area apply only half their usual fire resistance. Creatures with immunity to fire use an outcome one degree of success better than what they rolled, instead of gaining the usual benefit of immunity. The bodies of creatures reduced to 0 Hit Points by a balor's death throes are completely incinerated into fine ash.

abilities.name: Dimensional Dervish
abilities.desc: A balor can cast their 5th-rank innate Translocate with only a single action.

abilities.name: Dispelling Strike
abilities.desc:
Frequency once per round.

Trigger The balor hits a creature, object, or spell effect with a weapon Strike.

Effect The balor casts an innate Dispel Magic on the target of the triggering Strike.

abilities.name: Infuse Weapons
abilities.desc: Any weapon a balor wields becomes a +3 Major Striking Vorpal weapon made of cold iron and silver while the demon holds it. A weapon that isn't eligible for the vorpal rune doesn't gain its effects. The demon can conjure a whip made of flames with an Interact action. This whip gains the same benefits as other weapons the balor wields.

abilities.name: Lifedrinker
abilities.desc:
Trigger The balor kills a living creature that is at least 15th level.

Effect The balor drinks the triggering creature's life force and regains 10d8+80 healing Hit Points.

abilities.name: Whip Reposition
abilities.desc: When a balor Grabs a creature with a whip Strike, they can move the creature to any space in the whip's reach. The balor can move without ending the grab as long as the creature remains within the whip's reach, and the balor can move the creature to any other space in the whip's reach with an Interact action.

abilities.name: Improved Grab
abilities.desc:
Trigger The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Improved Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with as a free action. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Improved Grab as an action and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Improved Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

monadic-deva.name: Monadic Deva
monadic-deva.blurb: Monadic devas stand vigil along the River of Souls as it passes from the mortal realm into the Ethereal Plane. Those who seek to fish souls out for their own use stalk this metaphysical river, and it is against these predators that monadic devas fight. At other times, monadic devas work to guide newcomers to the River of Souls who might be in danger of drifting from the current and lingering as ghosts. Monadic devas often find their tasks place them in alliances with psychopomps, and they work well with the monitors despite the philosophical divide between their views on a soul's inherent goodness. A monadic deva is 7 feet tall and weighs 220 pounds.

abilities.name: Constant Spells
abilities.desc: A constant spell affects the monster without the monster needing to cast it, and its duration is unlimited. If a constant spell gets counteracted, the monster can reactivate it by spending the normal spellcasting actions the spell requires.

abilities.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
Spiritual Warden
abilities.desc:
20 feet. Allies in the aura gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against death effects and effects that target or manipulate their souls.

Effect: Spiritual Warden

abilities.name: Holy Armaments
abilities.desc: Any weapon gains the effect of a Holy property rune while a monadic deva wields it.

abilities.name: Rebuke Soul
abilities.desc:
The monadic deva speaks a word to cause a creature's soul to recoil at its sins or an undead creature to recoil at its lack of a soul. One non-good living or undead target within 40 feet takes 5d10 spirit damage and must attempt a DC 32 Fortitude save.

Regardless of the outcome, the target is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and is Stunned 1.

Failure The target takes full damage and is Stunned 2.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is Stunned 4.

abilities.name: Solid Blow
abilities.desc: When a monadic deva hits a target for the second time during its turn with its mace, it deals an additional 2d12 force damage as its weapon shimmers with ripples of power.

white-dracolisk.name: White Dracolisk
white-dracolisk.blurb: Dracolisks are rare magical crossbreeds of chromatic dragons and basilisks. None now know how they first came to be, but they have proven viable and can breed with one another as well as with basilisks. While a dracolisk appears much like a young true dragon of its parent type, its eight legs are an immediate indication that it is something more. Its coloration varies, depending on the nature of its draconic ancestry, though it's lighter on its underside and darker near its wing tips. A typical dracolisk is 15 feet long and weighs 3,000 pounds.

abilities.name: Tremorsense 30 feet
abilities.desc: Tremorsense allows a monster to feel the vibrations through a solid surface caused by movement. It is an imprecise sense with a limited range (listed in the ability). Tremorsense functions only if the monster is on the same surface as the subject, and only if the subject is moving along (or burrowing through) the surface.

abilities.name: Draconic Resistance
abilities.desc: A white dracolisk has resistance 10 to cold damage.

abilities.name: Petrifying Glance
abilities.desc:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet that the dracolisk can see starts its turn

Effect The target must attempt a DC 26 Fortitude save. If it fails, it becomes Slowed 1 for 1 minute as its body stiffens.

abilities.name: Breath Weapon
abilities.desc:
The white dracolisk breathes a 30-foot cone of energy. This breath weapon deals 6d10 cold damage, with a basic DC 28 Reflex save.

The dracolisk can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

abilities.name: Petrifying Gaze
abilities.desc:
The dracolisk stares at a creature it can see within 30 feet. That creature must attempt a DC 28 Fortitude save. If it fails and has not already been slowed by Petrifying Glance or this ability, it becomes Slowed 1. If the creature already was slowed by this ability or Petrifying Glance, a failed save causes the creature to be Petrified permanently.

A creature petrified in this manner can be instantly restored to flesh by being coated (not just splashed) with fresh dracolisk or basilisk blood no more than 1 hour old. A single dracolisk contains enough blood to coat 1d4+2 Medium creatures in this manner.

abilities.name: Savage Jaws
abilities.desc: The dracolisk makes a single Strike with its jaws. If the attack hits, it deals 4d12+16 piercing damage (versatile S). This counts as two attacks for its multiple attack penalty.
